mapper.select: SELECT B.B_IDX AS B_IDX, U.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, B.B_U_IDX AS B_U_IDX, B.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, B.B_CONTENT AS B_CONTENT, B.B_HITS AS B_HITS, DATE_FORMAT(B.B_DATE, '%y-%m-%d') AS B_DATE FROM BOARD B INNER JOIN USER U ON B.B_U_IDX = U.U_IDX

SELECT B.B_IDX AS B_IDX, B.B_U_IDX AS B_U_IDX, B.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, B.B_CONTENT AS B_CONTENT, B.B_HITS AS B_HITS, B.B_DATE AS B_DATE, B.B_MODIFY AS B_MODIFY, B.B_VOTE AS B_VOTE, B.B_DELETE AS B_DELETE, U.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, C.C_NAME AS C_NAME FROM BOARD B JOIN USER U ON B.B_U_IDX = U.U_IDX JOIN COMPANY C ON U.U_C_IDX = C.C_IDX ORDER BY B.B_IDX DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT B.B_IDX AS B_IDX, B.B_U_IDX AS B_U_IDX, B.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, B.B_CONTENT AS B_CONTENT, B.B_HITS AS B_HITS, B.B_DATE AS B_DATE, B.B_MODIFY AS B_MODIFY, B.B_VOTE AS B_VOTE, B.B_DELETE AS B_DELETE, U.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, C.C_NAME AS C_NAME FROM BOARD B JOIN USER U ON B.B_U_IDX = U.U_IDX JOIN COMPANY C ON U.U_C_IDX = C.C_IDX WHERE B.B_DELETE = 'N' AND B.B_IDX < #{lastBIdx} ORDER BY B.B_IDX DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT B.B_IDX AS B_IDX, B.B_U_IDX AS B_U_IDX, B.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, B.B_CONTENT AS B_CONTENT, B.B_HITS AS B_HITS, B.B_DATE AS B_DATE, B.B_MODIFY AS B_MODIFY, B.B_VOTE AS B_VOTE, B.B_DELETE AS B_DELETE, U.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, C.C_NAME AS C_NAME FROM BOARD B JOIN USER U ON B.B_U_IDX = U.U_IDX JOIN COMPANY C ON U.U_C_IDX = C.C_IDX WHERE B.B_IDX = #{b_idx}
